decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to establish control over the opponent by using powerful creatures and removal spells, combined with disruption effects such as Duress. The focus is on generating card advantage and efficiently removing threats from the opponent's side of the battlefield. The deck also includes cards that can generate additional value, such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Anoint with Affliction. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's strategy, with a mix of utility lands and basic Swamps to ensure consistent access to black mana.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, bounce spells, and card draw. It also utilizes creatures with powerful abilities to further control the game. The mana base is designed to provide a variety of colors while also including utility lands for additional advantage. The deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's strategy, control the pace of the game, and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast-paced aggro strategy using a combination of creatures with abilities that provide value such as Fear of Isolation, Nurturing Pixie, and Optimistic Scavenger. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and efficient removal spells like Go for the Throat. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares adds further pressure to the opponent. This deck also utilizes a mix of land cards to ensure consistency in mana production and support the aggressive game plan.

The key concept of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to quickly establish board control and apply pressure on the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and disruptive cards. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace of play and force the opponent to react to its threats, while also having options for card advantage and protecting its own creatures. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color mana requirements efficiently, allowing for consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the spells in the deck.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, pushing for early damage and maintaining pressure throughout the game. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck is designed to capitalize on early board presence and push for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the pieces of the Omniscience Combo, which enables you to cast spells from your hand without paying their mana cost. By using cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Moment of Truth to set up the combo, along with support cards like Ephara's Dispersal and Abuelo's Awakening, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with powerful spells and control effects. Utilizing card draw and resource management, this deck aims to quickly establish board dominance and lock down your opponent's options.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using a combination of efficient and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes some support cards like Witchstalker Frenzy and Monstrous Rage to help push through damage and secure the win.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to utilize a combination of card draw, removal, and counterspells to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By using cards like Three Steps Ahead, Temporary Lockdown, and Day of Judgment to control the board, along with Jace, the Perfected Mind for card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue opponents. Additionally, cards like Stock Up and Ride's End provide additional control options, while Beza, the Bounding Spring and Overlord of the Mistmoors offer valuable creatures to help close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt your opponent's strategy. This is achieved through cards like Temporary Lockdown, Get Lost, and Day of Judgment to remove threats from the board. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Overlord of the Hauntwoods and Zur, Eternal Schemer to maintain board control and pressure the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy with a mixture of different lands to ensure you have the mana you need when you need it.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By efficiently removing threats, disrupting the opponent's game plan with discard spells, and generating card advantage through card draw effects, the deck aims to stall the game and eventually win through powerful finishers like Jace, the Perfected Mind or Doomsday Excruciator. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both blue and black mana sources to cast the deck's spells effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of disruptive spells like Stock Up and Nowhere to Run, along with powerful creatures like Oildeep Gearhulk and Doomsday Excruciator. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining card advantage through spells like Beseech the Mirror and Grim Bauble. The deck also includes card draw engines like Jace, the Perfected Mind and Preacher of the Schism to ensure consistent resources. The mana base consists of dual lands to support the deck's color requirements for optimal performance.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Nurturing Pixie and Optimistic Scavenger, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Stormchaser's Talent, it aims to control the board and push through damage efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Hopeless Nightmare and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares adds an additional layer of disruption to keep the opponent off balance. With a mix of early aggression and versatile disruption, this deck aims to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. With cards like Hopeless Nightmare and Stormchaser's Talent, you can deal damage quickly and efficiently. Using Nurturing Pixie and Optimistic Scavenger to ramp up your mana, you can play out your threats early and often. Fear of Isolation helps to control the board while cards like Sheltered by Ghosts and Nowhere to Run protect your creatures. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provides a powerful finisher to close out games. With a mix of interaction and aggression, this deck aims to outpace and outmuscle your opponent.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Burst Lightning, and Monstrous Rage, you aim to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The creatures in this deck, such as Hired Claw and Manifold Mouse, are used to apply pressure and force your opponent to react defensively. With a mix of direct damage spells and efficient creatures, this deck seeks to maintain board presence and close out the game before your opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on leveraging cards that synergize with the ability to play without paying mana costs, enabling powerful combo plays that can overwhelm opponents quickly. It contains cards that can draw additional resources, disrupt opponents' strategies, and protect its key combo pieces. The deck aims to set up a board state where it can achieve a dominant position by casting multiple spells in a single turn and overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of powerful effects.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By combining the efficiency of cheap creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Hired Claw with powerful instant damage spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower, this deck aims to push through damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of spell support like Spell Pierce and Stormchaser's Talent helps protect your creatures and enhance your damage output. With a mix of creature aggression and direct damage spells, this deck aims to establish early board presence and lead to a swift victory.
